text:
My neighbor decided to take security seriously, putting up a sign that ominously read, "Beware of Dog." The irony hit its peak when the postman arrived. Out trotted my three-pound furball, a creature whose primary defense mechanism is to sneeze loudly. The postman looked down, paused, and deadpanned, "Oh no, I'm so scared!" That comment sparked a crisis of confidence in my tiny pup. Now, he’s on a relentless mission to prove the postman wrong, which mostly involves barking at his own shadow and trying to intimidate mail carriers with sheer, unadulterated cuteness. It’s a tough job, but someone has to do it.

By the way, the color of an eggplant is purple.
